spans.s:
1 मुष् मुष्णा॑ति (मो॑षति, मुषति), pp. मुषित॑ (q.v.)
rob, steal, plunder, rob or bereave of (2 acc.);
 carry off, ravish (lit.
& fig.);
 surpass, excel. - अभि rob of (2 acc.). अव, आ & निस् take
away, carry off. परि rob of (2 acc.). प्र rob, take away. withdraw.
वि & सम् rob, carry off.
2 मुष् robbing, taking away, destroying, surpassing (—˚).
मू॑ष् s. mouse.

मुषाय् मुषा˚य॑ति rob, snatch away. — आ = S. प्र
plunder.
मुषितक n. stolen property.
मुषीव॑न् m. robber, thief.
मुष्क॑ m. testicle, du. the vulva.
मुष्कदेश m. the region of the scrotum.
मुष्क॑भार a. having testicles.
मुष्कर॑ a. = prec.
मुष्कवन्त् a. = prec.

मुष्टि॑ f. fist, handful;
 handle, esp of a sword.
मुष्टिप्रहार m. blow with the fist.

मुष्टियुद्ध n. ˚हत्या॑ f. a fight with fists, hand
to hand engagement.
मुष्टिह॑न् m. fighting hand to hand.
मुष्टी@कृ clench the fist.
मु॑सल m. n. pestle, mace, club, bell-clapper.
मुसलिन् a. armed with a club.
मुस्त m. n., आ f. a kind of grass.
मुस्तक m. n., आ f. the same.
मूष m. the same.

मूषक m. thief, robber;
 mouse, rat.
मूषिकशावक m. young mouse, mousey.
मूषिकोत्कर m. mole-hill or mouse-hole.
